sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# SPACE to go to blue cross
result = action(['SPACE'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        b = n['boundary']
        print(f"Player at ({b[0][0]}, {b[0][1]})")

# Find the blue cross entity
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] > 20:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"Blue cross: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2}), span={max(rows)-min(rows)}x{max(cols)-min(cols)}")

containers = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
print(f"Containers: {len(containers)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
